traits.inflorescence.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010) p. 198, family Haloragaceae: inflorescence cyme (dichasial partial inflorescences), usually; read as {"cyme": "usually"}.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Wikipedia, Myriophyllum (half the family) (read 2026-10-16): often whorled, with alternate or opposite exceptions. Opposite leaves in Gonocarpus inferred.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Wikipedia, Myriophyllum (read 2026-10-16): whorled leaves; successive whorls alternate. Inferred from whorls.

traits.division_pattern.note: Wikipedia, Myriophyllum (read 2026-10-16): leaves finely pinnately divided.

traits.fruit_type.note: Wikipedia, Haloragaceae (read 2026-10-16): Myriophyllum a schizocarp of nutlets; other genera nuts or drupes.

traits.flowering_position.note: Wikipedia, Myriophyllum (read 2026-10-16): flowers usually in the axils of emergent leaves.

traits.perianth.note: Wikipedia, Myriophyllum (read 2026-10-16): female flowers usually lack petals.
